name: Act of Mercy
source:
After awakening in a lavish yet sinister theater, you are commanded by your mysterious captor to cure your amnesia in order to find the succor you so desperately need. 

What secrets lie in your strange past? What former glories can you claim? And what will you do when you discover it all?

[From [url=https://zircona.itch.io/act-of-mercy]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你在一座富麗堂皇卻又陰森不祥的劇院裡醒來。把你囚禁於此的神秘人命令你治好自己的失憶症，只有這樣，你才能找到眼下迫切需要的援助。

你離奇的過去裡藏著什麼秘密？曾經有哪些榮耀屬於你？等你弄清這一切，又會怎麼做？

［摘自[url=https://zircona.itch.io/act-of-mercy]Itch.io[/url]］
